summary: This visual presents a template-based interface designed to assist users in understanding and managing planning tasks. It features two parts: the first part lists various suggested questions that users can ask to clarify their goals and conflicts, while the second part illustrates a conversational interaction where the system explains the complexities of conflicting goals among family members. Key topics include the resolution of conflicts, specific examples of goals, and the importance of prioritizing preferences. The interface aims to guide users in navigating their planning challenges effectively.
